_why: Golden key list for AICallMetadata — the ONE contract carrying prompt/completion TEXT, asserted from BOTH the TypeScript and the Python suites. The gap this closes was live, not hypothetical: apps/ai-service populated `prompt_text`/`response_text` (post-pseudonymization) while `AICallMetadataSchema` was a bare `z.object` with no such fields, so Zod STRIPPED both — silently, no error, no data — and the trace writer fell back to the API-side request object, i.e. the worker's raw name, phone and address. Both suites were green throughout. A model this file does not list, or a field only one side declares, is now a failure on the other side.
